head: 7 new photo and video apps climbing the App Store this week
dek: These photo and video apps came out in the last 60 days and rose into the US App Store's Photo & Video charts this week, from Flipcorder: Retro Camcorder to SharpStop Depth of Field Calc.
where: iPhone and iPad, US App Store charts this week
means: If you're looking for something new in photo and video, these are small apps people are buying right now.
todo: Open each app's App Store page to check the price, in-app purchases and what it needs before you download.

list.name: Flipcorder: Retro Camcorder
list.what: Records 20-second clips onto a daily tape and plays them back as one home movie.

list.name: Inward Photo
list.what: A private, offline way to rediscover the photos already on your phone.

list.name: 4perf
list.what: A camera with automatic exposure and Night Boost for low light.

list.name: Duopaper: Panoramic Wallpapers
list.what: Wallpapers that reveal a bigger scene when you unfold the phone.

list.name: Snapshots: Instant Film Camera
list.what: An instant camera and photo booth where each photo develops on screen.

list.name: Frames - Edit and Organize
list.what: Makes your camera roll searchable and editable, all on your phone.

list.name: SharpStop Depth of Field Calc
list.what: Shows what will be sharp before you press the shutter.
